required_stages.description: 2-D (batch*M, K) views of X and Y; allocate Y inside run().
Per row: fp32 mean and biased variance over the full row, rstd = rsqrt(var + eps).
Per row: (X - mean) * rstd * WEIGHT + BIAS in fp32, cast once to X.dtype, stored.

forbidden_substitutions.message: library layer normalisation computes the operator
PyTorch computation of the row statistics on the data path
host-side cast of the affine parameters

outputs.aliasing: none: fresh tensor with X's shape/dtype allocated inside run()

timing_boundary.notes: Views, allocation and launch(es) are all inside run() and timed; WEIGHT/BIAS are read per call; no cross-call cache of statistics or parameters.
